description: This file defines the 'Option' model class for the OpenCart admin catalog module, providing methods to manage option entities in the database such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving options, descriptions, and associated values.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Model class for managing product options in the OpenCart admin catalog, including functions for CRUD operations on options and their descriptions and values.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Creates a new option record in the database, inserts related descriptions and values if provided, and returns the new option's ID.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Updates an existing option record and its associated descriptions and values based on provided data.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Deletes an option record and its associated descriptions and values from the database.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option record by its ID, including its description for the current language.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of options filtered and sorted based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalOptions
methods.description: Returns the total number of option records in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an option in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific option.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all option descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given option, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all option descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Creates a new value entry for an option, including optional descriptions, and returns its ID.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with a specific option ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value record by its ID, including the current language's description.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values for an option, filtered by language and ordered by sort order and name.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an option value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByOptionId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions associated with a specific option.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all value descriptions for a specific option, structured by value.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all value descriptions for a specific language.
